data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jecho is recorded in name-lists as “God is healer”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jecho expresses “God is healer”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jecho total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
